forms.title: Teamtailor career site application (Rails/Stimulus, Dropzone direct-to-S3 CV upload)
quirks: qualifying questions come BEFORE the contact fields
questions carry hidden question_id + picked_question_id; boolean answers are radios valued true/false
multiple choice rendered as a button + role=menu of menuitemcheckbox buttons mirroring hidden choices[] checkboxes
'Apply with LinkedIn' button and hidden candidate[linkedin_*] fields that must stay empty
intl-tel-input phone (default GB +44, separate dial code); the full international number is written into the input at submit time
Dropzone 'Drop your file or upload': its hidden input.dz-hidden-input is appended to <body>, outside the form; the file goes straight to an S3 POST and only candidate[resume_remote_url] is submitted
Rails hidden "0" twins before every consent checkbox; only the privacy consent is required
rails-ujs remote form: multipart FormData via fetch to /applications with X-CSRF-Token, then redirect
forms.reference: Live career.teamtailor.com/jobs/<id>-<slug>/applications/new markup (form#job-application-form, Stimulus controllers, upload translations), studied read-only
